name: usePerfetto
summary: System-level kernel and app performance profiling via Perfetto v54.
plain: Controls high-precision Linux kernel ftrace and Android atrace performance profiling directly from React Native. Captures Tensor G6 CPU frequency scaling, Choreographer frame rendering, and custom app trace sections into .perfetto-trace files viewable in ui.perfetto.dev.
description: Backed by android.os.Trace, the system Perfetto binary (v54), and Android kernel trace categories (sched, freq, idle, gfx, view, am, wm, camera, hal). Emits zero-overhead hardware trace markers and captures system trace buffers without requiring root privileges. Nothing is simulated: operates directly on physical Android tracing infrastructure.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether Perfetto and system tracing are available on device.

returns.name: isTracing
returns.desc: Whether an active system trace session is currently recording.

returns.name: perfettoVersion
returns.desc: Perfetto daemon version ('v54.0' on Android 17 / Pixel 11 Pro).

returns.name: activeCategories
returns.desc: Categories currently being captured in active trace.

returns.name: lastTraceUri
returns.desc: Local file URI of the last saved .perfetto-trace file.

returns.name: traceDurationMs
returns.desc: Duration of the last completed trace session in milliseconds.

returns.name: startTrace
returns.desc: Start a system trace session with specified categories and buffer size.

returns.name: stopTrace
returns.desc: Stop the active trace session and write the .perfetto-trace file.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-probe Perfetto daemon and tracing subsystem.
